<u>**Statistical and Modeling Learning Objectives:**</u>

1. Explain CoGAPS as linked non-negative matrices: gene loadings that define patterns and cell scores that measure pattern use.
1. Evaluate candidate values of K using rank-sweep evidence, including stability, redundancy, temporal signal, biological resolution, and goal-aligned evidence.
1. Justify why one CoGAPS rank is used for the main analysis while a lower-rank model remains useful as a sensitivity comparison.
1. Read convergence, stability, runtime, and trace diagnostics before treating selected-model output as interpretable.
1. Distinguish high non-negative pattern scores or gene loadings from gene-expression direction.
1. Use pseudobulk directionality to ask whether top pattern genes increase or decrease relative to baseline.
1. Explain why subject-level summaries are important when interpreting temporal patterns in single-cell data.
